note: Tax treatment policy of the demo company (US, home currency USD). See app/tax_treatment.py and the README section 'Accounting considerations'. Withholding taxes are always booked as a liability, whatever this file says.

rules.note: US sales tax paid on purchases is part of the cost (no input-tax credit).
Foreign VAT, GST and consumption tax: not reclaimed by default. A company that files refund claims sets the countries concerned to recoverable.
